name: forecast
description: Harvest time tracking and Harvest Forecast scheduled allocations.
long_description:
Exposes two Harvest APIs side by side: **Harvest** for what was actually burned — projects, tasks, users, time entries and time reports — and **Forecast** for what is *scheduled* — allocations, people and their capacity, placeholders, milestones and time off.

Everything is read-only apart from five timesheet write tools (`create_time_entry`, `update_time_entry`, `delete_time_entry`, `restart_time_entry`, `stop_time_entry`), which let the assistant record time on your behalf and prompt before each write. No other Harvest write endpoint is exposed.

authorization_bearer.title: Harvest personal access token
authorization_bearer.description: Create one at https://id.getharvest.com/developers. The same token authenticates both the Harvest and the Forecast API.

harvest_account_id.title: Harvest account ID
harvest_account_id.description: Shown next to the token at https://id.getharvest.com/developers, under the account with a product of 'harvest'.

forecast_account_id.title: Forecast account ID
forecast_account_id.description: A different number from the Harvest account ID: it is the numeric id in the Forecast web URL, https://forecastapp.com/<id>/schedule/team. Leave blank to use the Harvest tools only — the forecast__ tools will then report that it is missing.
